root.name: MCP Server
root.shortdesc: Exposes GLPI as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so AI assistants can work with tickets, the knowledge base, users/groups, and the service catalog.
root.note: Private plugin - distribution to GLPI Cloud customer instances is arranged directly with Teclib per the private-plugin mechanism. This descriptor is a preview draft; the download_url above is a placeholder pending the protected distribution endpoint.
